reviewQuestion: Does the December 2022 $24.8M TIA and May 2, 2024 additional $34.4M belong to one amended agreement, and can each historical amount and operative day be independently supported by the executed/issuer sources?
limitation: Currently recorded $59.2M is the amended ceiling, not $59.2M plus $24.8M. The directly relevant May 2, 2024 issuer Form 8-K must be separately registered and checked before amount-version promotion. Grant receipts are not versions.

reviewQuestion: Is the original 2022 up-to-€18.7M award the same grant contract as the later approximately €14.8M at a 23% rate, and what primary document establishes the actual revision-effective date?
limitation: Original announcement and 2026 retrospective reporting do not by themselves identify the binding grant amendment day. Different up_to versus approximately qualifiers matter; US-dollar receipts are not grant face amounts.

reviewQuestion: Trace the original 2023 up-to-$15.5M OTIA through each additional award to its later approximately $27.1M estimate; determine independently supported operative bounds and whether estimate/ceiling qualifiers changed.
limitation: Do not equate amended estimated value with cash reimbursed or assume every new tranche was automatically operative on the announcement date. This Army OTIA is distinct from the separate DPA TIA.

reviewQuestion: Determine whether January 2023 conditional DOE support and the January 2025 closed $996M guarantee meet the same-instrument continuity standard for amount history or instead represent a pre-closing indication superseded at binding close.
limitation: Conditional commitment is not automatically a historical executed guarantee. Do not create an original-version amount until legal identity, treatment of the replaced conditional package, and source-effective boundaries are established.
